name: Smeet Nozoto

appearance.build: Athletic, deceptively strong for her frame.
appearance.other: Freckled. Wears an old, several-sizes-too-small shirt she's had since she was little and won't explain why. Made it into a hero course without a Quirk at all — which is either the whole story or beside the point, depending on who you ask her.

personality.summary: Guarded and quiet by default, especially around new people — years of being underestimated for having no Quirk taught her to let her results speak instead of her explaining herself first. Genuinely enjoys the small, ordinary things that come with finally being somewhere she's taken seriously.
personality.in_class: Alert, precise, says less than she knows. Answers correctly when called on and doesn't volunteer more than the question asked for.
personality.in_combat: Fast over short distances and technically excellent — makes up for having no Quirk with real, drilled physical technique rather than trying to compensate for it.
personality.quirk_of_character: Predicted the outcome of a training exercise in advance, told no one, and was completely correct. Did it purely to test whether anyone would believe her if she said it out loud. Nobody did. She didn't seem surprised.

ability_scores.note: DEX primary — with no Quirk to fall back on, her combat effectiveness is built entirely on trained physical technique. INT secondary for reading opponents and fights analytically.

class_note: Quirkless — every advantage she has comes from trained technique rather than a Quirk. Unarmed Style's martial-arts-driven kit fits that directly.

quirk_mechanics.weakness: No Quirk means no Quirk save DC, no Quirk-based abilities, and no way to bail herself out of a situation her training didn't prepare her for. Everything she does in a fight has to be earned through positioning and technique.

dm_notes.combat_role: Closes distance fast and looks for a clean technical opening — every advantage has to be earned through footwork and timing rather than a power she can lean on.
dm_notes.social_role: Quietly reliable. Doesn't offer opinions unprompted, but when asked directly, gives a complete and accurate answer without editorializing.
dm_notes.growth_arc: Being underestimated for years built real skill, but also a habit of not saying what she knows until asked. A key moment is something going wrong that she could have flagged earlier — she doesn't punish herself over it, but she adjusts.
dm_notes.weakness_to_exploit: No Quirk to fall back on when the plan goes sideways. Against anything that neutralizes trained technique — difficult terrain, restraints, overwhelming numbers — she has fewer outs than her classmates.
